records.queue_decision_unchanged: I3 in frozen original queue; no final systematic inclusion

code_evidence_basis.C1: DFT/MD reference atomic-state generation, pp3-4 and15-19; route-specific architecture/loss tags require separate method-level coding.
code_evidence_basis.V2: Author-reported quantified DFT-reference RDF/ADF/EoS/PEC comparisons, pp8-10 and26-43; no independent local physical validation.
code_evidence_basis.M1: Semiconductor material simulations and properties; no inspectable external production/wafer cohort.

generation.reference_data: DFT molecular-dynamics atomic states with energy and force labels; extended-XYZ raw/sampled SiN/HfO datasets.
generation.learned_route: Atomic configuration -> MLFF energy/forces -> MD integration -> synthetic trajectories and property evaluation.
generation.not_demonstrated: Wafer inspection images, measured film dynamics, manufacturing defect formation or calibrated fab production.

claims.paraphrase: VASP/PBE DFT and modified melt-quench-anneal generate simulated SiN/HfO reference atomic states. Raw snapshots, sampled splits and per-atom data points are different dataset counts; the2.6k GPU-day corpus cost is not a third-party released-data inference budget.

Energy-gradient force models and direct-force models must be distinguished. GemNet-dT avoids energy backpropagation and is explicitly described as non-energy-conserving in the main paper; benchmark-level physics-based data cannot certify all learned trajectories.

Original sampled ID data use an8:1:1 train/validation/test split. OOD training-error tests, MD composition/phase changes and static EoS structures have different denominators. Snapshot count is not the number of independent trajectories or wafer/site holdouts.

The authors compare RDF, ADF, bulk modulus, equilibrium volume and PEC against DFT reference data. These quantified simulator/property comparisons support author-reported V2, not independent experimental-film/metrology validation.

HfO OOD dynamic simulations have interrupted RDF/ADF entries: Allegro with both losses and MACE with MAE in TablesD6/D7. FigureD8 shows Allegro Hf collision; failed entries must not disappear from completion/failure denominators.

Radar scores use the minimum observed cohort error and chosen maximum thresholds; five axes include EF,RDF,ADF,B0,V0 while PEC remains separately reported. The main figure selects MAE/MSE variants by total indicator score. Neither the plot nor its aggregate is a universal industrial acceptance score.

Training uses200epochs and model-dependent batches chosen for V100 memory. Data scaling fixes update budgets rather than epochs. DPA-1 runs in a different TensorFlow framework; OC20 also changes training recipe and cannot silently be pooled with SiN/HfO results.

The text describes averaging the last3ps using50snapshots at6fs intervals, which spans approximately0.3ps rather than3ps. TableD1 also includes a2376-atom HfO OOD system below the narrative2592 minimum. These are source/code clarification questions, not established defects in the repository.

The acquired official-source PDF acknowledges new Allegro configurations released in January2024 and reports the benchmark used a version before February2023. Historical performance should be attached to model/configuration version rather than asserted as a current family-wide result.
DFT-derived RDF/ADF/EoS/PEC alignment provides physical proxies. Statements connecting these to thin-film use do not supply measured wafer outcomes or a calibrated process integration envelope.

design_limitations.issue: References are DFT/MD data; correlation across snapshots and exact source/trajectory partitioning must be audited.
Force route/conservation is model-variant-specific. A source-data C1 label does not give every MLFF a conservation guarantee.
OOD MD interruptions and high-energy extrapolation failures must remain explicit; no measured fab or film trajectory qualification.
Average-window interval and atom-range statements require pinned-code/data reconciliation before matching the property protocol.
Cohort-relative scores and model/loss variant selection must not become universal acceptance or independent held-out evaluation.
Allegro configuration update is acknowledged; claims belong to the evaluated historical version.
A documented framework/data route is not acquired pinned code, trained model, MD execution or clean-start resource measurement.

open_questions: Pin top-level commit, all submodules/patches, data checksums and inference-ready trained checkpoints before a bounded clean-start MD run.
Reconcile the3ps/50snapshot/6fs averaging statements and exact dynamic reference structures against pinned configuration and data.
Preserve interruptions separately from missing measurements and publish denominator by structure, loss, version, temperature and composition.
Select tolerances before evaluation; measure energy-force consistency, trajectory stability and DFT-reference property error without borrowing cohort-relative radar scores as physical gates.
Evaluate conservative and direct-force routes separately, including integrator/thermostat/boundary conditions and hardware/time/memory.
Resolve each code/data/model/submodule/upstream rights scope and verify measured film/process transfer before industrial qualification.

code_evidence_basis.C1: Reference optics/resist/ILT generates physical observation proxies, pp3-6. Individual trained inverse objectives, e.g.NeuralILT p8, need method-level C3 coding separately.
code_evidence_basis.V2: Author-reported quantified reference-model nominal/process-corner/EPE metrics, pp6-9; not measured wafer validation.
code_evidence_basis.M1: Circuit design layouts and simulated resist outputs; design-data origin is distinct from actual manufactured sensor/metrology data.

generation.reference_data: Synthetic MetalSet layouts plus circuit-derived ViaSet and standard-cell designs; optimized masks and aerial/resist images generated by reference lithography/ILT.
generation.forward_surrogate: Optimized mask -> predicted aerial and printed images.
generation.inverse_generation: Target pattern -> candidate optimized mask -> reference-simulator evaluation; optional separate refinement stage.
generation.not_demonstrated: Measured printed-wafer labels or calibrated fab process-window/production acceptance.

claims.paraphrase: Lithography simulation predicts aerial/resist images from an optimized mask. Inverse mask generation predicts a mask from a target layout. Both use a Hopkins optical and resist reference model; they have different inputs, outputs, training targets and evaluation denominators.

MetalSet is synthesized according to ICCAD13 design rules; ViaSet is generated from OpenROAD gcd/aes designs; StdMetal/StdContact use Nangate45nm standard cells. Circuit-derived design patterns do not supply measured manufactured-wafer labels.

Simulation test counts differ from mask-optimization10case MetalSet/ViaSet tests. StdMetal uses271test tiles without adaptation; StdContact uses163adaptation tiles and165test tiles. That transfer result is not fully unseen zero-adaptation testing.

The133496 printed total differs from133446 obtained by Table1 simulation subset counts; ViaSet construction116415 differs from116375 in Table1. Eq8 repeats a Zmax argument and uses Zmax in its target-error term despite nominal-L2 Eq5. Keep these as provenance/code questions, not silently corrected data or proven code bugs.

PA Eq10 divides the foreground intersection by target foreground, resembling foreground recall rather than all-pixel accuracy. EPE counts probe violations; shots count decomposed rectangles. Nominal mismatch, variation robustness, mask complexity and timing require separate interpretation.

Author experiments use RTX3090 and different model resolutions; DOINN leads simulation averages, while mask optimization trades L2/EPE/PVB/shots. NeuralILT has best displayed average L2/EPE, GANOPC best average PVB and CFNO lowest average shots. No single all-metric best follows.

Quantified reference-model optical/resist/corner evaluations support author-reported V2 and source-data C1. Applying a32nm reference to45nm layouts is an author modeling assumption, not independently calibrated fab qualification. Individual NeuralILT objectives explicitly use physics-linked L2 and PVB.

ViaSet crops2048nm tiles with512nm stride and retains central1280nm patterns. Neighboring tiles may share context; exact circuit/spatial partition membership needs audit before independent-design claims. This reading does not establish realized train/test leakage.

design_limitations.issue: Labels and process corners come from the reference simulator, not measured wafers; optical/resist calibration and32nm-to45nm transfer need independent checks.
Task-specific test counts and163tile StdContact adaptation must accompany generalization claims.
Overlapping circuit crops may share context; inspect exact spatial/circuit memberships before independent-design inference.
Dataset totals and Eq8 have source consistency questions requiring pinned assets/code; do not silently alter paper counts.
PA,EPE,shots and runtime have distinct units/definitions. Model resolution/hardware and optional refinement affect comparisons.
Code release and adaptive-boxes MIT observation do not establish model/kernel/layout/output commercial rights or industrial process acceptance.

open_questions: Reconcile dataset totals, Eq8 target corner/arguments and PA reference definition with pinned data and scripts.
Audit spatial/circuit split overlap and163tile adaptation; report task-specific10/1648/11642/271/165 denominators explicitly.
Separate pretraining, learned initialization, optional refinement and complete mask manufacturing metrics in reproducible recipes.
Predefine nominal-error, process-window, EPE, shots and resource thresholds; a better L2 does not compensate for PVB failure.
Audit kernel/resist calibration, wavelength/process envelope and measured-wafer transfer before physical or industrial claims.
Establish model/kernel/layout/dependency/output rights and verified packaging for practical industrial reuse.
